turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who made that decision, and when?
I'm waiting, Hale. Did anyone speak to Owen before that mark went into the gradebook?
You obviously put the hours in with him. His reading level is years ahead of the class.
Don't manage me, Hale. If his reading is years ahead, explain the zero. What do you have besides software?
You're the kind of parent I wish every kid had.
Save it. I came here for evidence, not compliments, and the clock is running.
So I'd love your blessing to handle this my way. I trust your judgment, and I hope you'll trust mine.
Your way put a zero on his phone before anyone called me, Hale. Procedure 4.2 says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered. Withdraw it, or I go to the principal today.
